description: CCVP/1 consistency resolution over signed certificates. Every target and every snapshot is a CCSP/1 certificate of the conformance domain (system_id "certcrypt", rules_version "rules/conformance"). A conforming implementation verifies each certificate under the Issued route, derives each snapshot issuer from its issuer signature (signer.id + composite key fingerprint, CCVP/1 Section 8.1), checks each snapshot's object, timestamps and subject.context-snapshot/1 commitment, and reproduces every expected outcome from the public rules alone.

outcome_semantics.consistency-match: an applicable entry in the governing snapshot covers this issuance
outcome_semantics.consistency-mismatch: a snapshot governs and no entry covers the key that signed
outcome_semantics.consistency-unknown: no snapshot governs, the context is equivocal or unreadable, or there is no verification unit

non_claims: A consistency outcome is NOT a trust class and NOT a partial form of Independent (CCVP/1 Section 10). consistency-unknown invalidates nothing. An implementation that feeds any of these outcomes into an Issued or Independent verdict is non-conformant.
namespace_note: The target names its snapshot issuer by label AND composite key fingerprint (payload.context). A snapshot signed by another key is outside the namespace whatever its signer.id: the namespace_impersonation cases pin that.
timestamp_note: C.payload.anchor.issued_at is the target's issuance time; S.payload.snapshot.issued_at is the snapshot's effective time. All CCVP/1 timestamps use the UTC form of CCSP/1 anchor.issued_at and are compared as instants, never as strings.

T_apr.note: acme, issued 2026-04-12, one subject.binary/1 subject, declares the ctx namespace

T_apr_kid.note: as T_apr, and the issuer signature carries kid "acme-key-2026"

T_mar_fraction.note: acme, issued at 2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z: the same instant as 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z, which sorts AFTER it as a string

T_rotated.note: signer.id "acme" but signed by another key (acme-rotated)

T_no_fingerprint.note: payload.context names the snapshot issuer by label only, without its key fingerprint

T_tampered.note: T_apr with its issuance time changed after signing: the issuer signature fails

S_jan.note: effective 2026-01-01: acme active from 2026-01-01, open-ended, no kid

S_mar_revoked.note: effective 2026-03-01: acme revoked, window closed at 2026-03-01

S_jan_identical.note: another certificate carrying a snapshot byte-identical to S_jan

S_jan_equivocal.note: same effective time as S_jan, different snapshot (no entries)

S_jan_respelled.note: S_jan with its effective time spelled 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z: same instant, different canonical bytes

S_kid.note: effective 2026-01-01: the acme entry names kid "acme-key-2026"

S_scope_email.note: effective 2026-01-01: the acme entry is restricted to subject.email/1

S_roles_other.note: effective 2026-01-01: the acme entry applies only to a role CCSP/1 never signs under

S_other_set.note: signed by ctx, covers acme, but for context_set_id "other-set"

S_bad_commitment.note: effective 2026-02-01, validly signed, but its subject.context-snapshot/1 commitment is over a different snapshot than the one it carries

S_bad_timestamp.note: validly signed, commitment correct, but its effective time carries a numeric offset, outside the CCVP/1 timestamp form

S_impostor_empty.note: signer.id "ctx-issuer" but signed by another key; effective 2026-02-15, no entries

S_impostor_covering.note: signer.id "ctx-issuer" but signed by another key; carries S_jan's snapshot

S_tampered.note: S_mar_revoked altered after signing: its issuer signature fails

S_bare_value.note: S_jan's snapshot value on its own, not a certificate

cases.name: eligible_at_issuance
cases.why: S_jan governs and its entry binds acme's label and composite key fingerprint

cases.name: no_snapshot_at_all
cases.why: no snapshot governs; absence invalidates nothing

cases.name: before_any_snapshot
cases.why: the only snapshot takes effect after issuance

cases.name: published_after_issuance
cases.why: a snapshot cannot reach back before its effective time

cases.name: retired_later_still_covered
cases.why: selection is by issuance time: the March revocation is not effective in February

cases.name: revoked_before_issuance
cases.why: S_mar_revoked governs April and its entry is not active

cases.name: instant_not_string
cases.why: 2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z is the instant 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z, so S_mar_revoked governs; a string comparison would select S_jan and answer match

cases.name: window_open
cases.why: valid_from <= issued_at < valid_to

cases.name: window_closed
cases.why: issued after valid_to: the window is half-open at the top

cases.name: context_equivocation
cases.why: two different snapshots share the maximal effective time

cases.name: identical_tie_is_one_snapshot
cases.why: the tied snapshots have identical canonical bytes

cases.name: respelled_tie_is_equivocation
cases.why: same instant, different canonical bytes: equivocation

cases.name: substituted_key_does_not_inherit
cases.why: the label matches but the key fingerprint does not

cases.name: kid_in_entry_and_signature
cases.why: the entry's kid equals the signature's

cases.name: kid_in_entry_only
cases.why: the entry names a kid the signature does not carry

cases.name: kid_in_signature_only
cases.why: an entry without kid ignores the signature's kid

cases.name: scope_excludes_profile
cases.why: the only matching entry is scoped to subject.email/1 and T_apr has none

cases.name: scope_includes_profile
cases.why: T_email has a subject.email/1 subject

cases.name: role_excludes
cases.why: the entry's roles do not contain "issuer"

cases.name: foreign_context_set_does_not_govern
cases.why: same snapshot issuer, other context_set_id

cases.name: namespace_impersonation_is_ignored
cases.why: S_impostor_empty borrows the label ctx-issuer but not its key; were it admitted it would govern April and answer mismatch

cases.name: namespace_impersonation_alone
cases.why: a snapshot signed by another key under the same label is outside the namespace

cases.name: tampered_snapshot_discarded
cases.why: a snapshot that is not Issued-valid takes no part

cases.name: tampered_snapshot_beside_valid
cases.why: the altered revocation is discarded, S_jan governs

cases.name: bare_snapshot_value_ignored
cases.why: snapshots are certificates; a bare value has no signature and no issuer

cases.name: non_conformant_snapshot_blocks
cases.why: a non-conformant snapshot from the namespace key, effective between the selected snapshot and issuance, cannot be skipped

cases.name: bad_timestamp_blocks
cases.why: an unreadable effective time from the namespace key cannot be skipped

cases.name: superseded_non_conformant_ignored
cases.why: the non-conformant snapshot is older than the selected S_mar_revoked

cases.name: target_not_issued_valid
cases.why: a target that is not Issued-valid has no issuer signature to bind

cases.name: target_without_context
cases.why: no declared context namespace

cases.name: namespace_without_fingerprint
cases.why: a namespace named by label alone is incomplete
